title: config coverage: what a prefix entry would newly allow
description:
What a prefix entry of `[commands] allow_prefix` or `[sandbox]
network_allow_prefix` would newly allow: every distinct argv the
project's journal recorded that it covers and the current policy does
not allow. A prefix is saved only as the confirmation of this preview,
and only when it is complete.

complete.description: Every run in the journal was read.

unreadable.description: What could not be read, and why (never "covers nothing").

rows.description: The argvs it would newly allow.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the entry, the rows and `complete`: what a save names.

CoverageRow.description: One argv a prefix would newly allow.

count.description: How often the journal records it.

last_at.description: Seconds since the epoch of the latest run that called it.

decided.description: How it was decided then, with how often.

still_asks.description:
A rule asks for it (or denies it) whatever the list says: the
rule's reason. The row stays so.

CoverageDecision.description: How calls of one argv were decided.
